behaviours.title: Deposits are rounded to the cent with halves going up
behaviours.when: 10.005 is deposited into account 'a' and 10.004 into account 'b'
behaviours.then: the balance of 'a' is 10.01 and the balance of 'b' is 10
behaviours.contrary_then: the half cent is rounded down (or to even) and the balance of 'a' is 10.00

behaviours.title: A deposit that rounds to zero cents is still accepted and recorded as 0
behaviours.when: 0.004 is deposited into account 'a' with transaction 'd1'
behaviours.then: the deposit is accepted, the balance stays 0 and the history holds a deposit entry of amount 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the deposit is rejected with reason 'amount-too-small'

behaviours.title: Zero or negative deposits are rejected and do not use up the transaction id
behaviours.when: 0 is deposited with transaction 't1', then -5 with 't1', then 100 with 't1'
behaviours.then: the first two are rejected with reason 'invalid-amount' and the deposit of 100 is accepted, balance 100
behaviours.contrary_then: a deposit of 0 is accepted as a harmless no-op

behaviours.title: Repeating a deposit transaction id is a silent no-op, even on another account
behaviours.given: 100 has been deposited into 'a' with transaction 't1'
behaviours.when: 50 is deposited into 'a' with 't1', and 50 into 'b' with 't1'
behaviours.then: both calls report ok, 'a' stays at 100 with one entry, and 'b' stays at 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the second deposit is applied and 'a' becomes 150

behaviours.title: An unknown account reads as balance 0 with empty history
behaviours.when: the balance and entries of 'ghost' are read
behaviours.then: the balance is 0 and the entries are an empty list
behaviours.contrary_then: reading an unknown account raises an error

behaviours.title: Opening an existing account does not reset it
behaviours.when: open('a') is called
behaviours.then: the balance is still 100 and the history still has 1 entry
behaviours.contrary_then: the account is reset to balance 0

behaviours.title: A foreign deposit is multiplied by the rate and recorded as a plain deposit
behaviours.when: depositForeign of 100 at rate 1.5 into 'a' with transaction 'f1'
behaviours.then: the balance is 150 and the history holds a 'deposit' entry of 150
behaviours.contrary_then: the amount is divided by the rate and the balance becomes 66.67

behaviours.title: A converted half cent is rounded up, not to even
behaviours.when: depositForeign of 1.25 at rate 0.5 into 'a' (exactly 0.625)
behaviours.then: the balance is 0.63
behaviours.contrary_then: the half cent is rounded to even and the balance is 0.62

behaviours.title: A foreign deposit with a zero or negative rate or amount is 'invalid-amount'
behaviours.when: depositForeign of 100 at rate 0, of 100 at rate -1.5, and of -100 at rate 1.5
behaviours.then: all three are rejected with reason 'invalid-amount' and the balance stays 0
behaviours.contrary_then: a rate of 0 is rejected with reason 'amount-too-small'

behaviours.title: A foreign deposit worth less than half a cent is 'amount-too-small'
behaviours.when: depositForeign of 0.004 at rate 1 ('f1'), then of 0.005 at rate 1 ('f2')
behaviours.then: the first is rejected with reason 'amount-too-small'; the second is accepted and the balance becomes 0.01
behaviours.contrary_then: the 0.004 deposit is accepted and recorded as 0, like a plain deposit

behaviours.title: Repeating a foreign deposit transaction id is a no-op
behaviours.when: depositForeign of 100 at rate 1.5 with 'f1' is called twice
behaviours.then: both report ok and the balance is 150
behaviours.contrary_then: both are applied and the balance is 300

behaviours.title: A small withdrawal is charged the minimum fee of 0.50
behaviours.when: 10 is withdrawn
behaviours.then: the fee is 0.50 (1% would be 0.10) and the balance becomes 89.5
behaviours.contrary_then: only the 1% fee of 0.10 is charged and the balance becomes 89.9

behaviours.title: The fee is recorded inside the withdrawal entry, not as its own entry
behaviours.given: a balance of 100 in 'a' from deposit 'd1'
behaviours.when: 10 is withdrawn with transaction 'w1'
behaviours.then: the history is the deposit of 100 followed by one 'withdrawal' entry of 10.5
behaviours.contrary_then: the history shows a 'withdrawal' entry of 10 and a separate fee entry of 0.50

behaviours.title: A 1% fee with a fraction of a cent is rounded up
behaviours.when: 60.01 is withdrawn (1% is 0.6001)
behaviours.then: the fee is 0.61 and the balance becomes 39.38
behaviours.contrary_then: the fee is rounded to the nearest cent, 0.60, and the balance becomes 39.39

behaviours.title: The withdrawal fee is capped at 25
behaviours.when: 3000 is withdrawn (1% would be 30)
behaviours.then: the fee is 25 and the balance becomes 975
behaviours.contrary_then: the full 1% fee of 30 is charged and the balance becomes 970

behaviours.title: Withdrawing the whole balance is refused because the fee must also fit
behaviours.when: 100 is withdrawn, then 99 is withdrawn
behaviours.then: the 100 withdrawal is rejected with 'insufficient-funds'; the 99 withdrawal (fee 0.99) is accepted, leaving 0.01
behaviours.contrary_then: the 100 withdrawal is accepted because only the amount is checked against the balance

behaviours.title: A withdrawal that leaves exactly 0 after the fee is allowed
behaviours.when: 10.01 is withdrawn, then 10 is withdrawn
behaviours.then: 10.01 is rejected with 'insufficient-funds' (10.01 + 0.50 > 10.50); 10 is accepted and the balance becomes 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the 10 withdrawal is rejected because the balance must stay above 0

behaviours.title: Withdrawals are limited to 5000 in total per account; once used up, even 0.01 is refused
behaviours.when: 5000 is withdrawn, then 0.01 is withdrawn
behaviours.then: 5000 is accepted (balance 4975 after the 25 fee); 0.01 is rejected with 'daily-limit'
behaviours.contrary_then: the 0.01 withdrawal is accepted

behaviours.title: The fee does not count towards the withdrawal limit
behaviours.when: 4990 is withdrawn (4990 plus the 25 fee is 5015)
behaviours.then: it is accepted and the balance becomes 4985
behaviours.contrary_then: it is rejected with 'daily-limit' because amount plus fee exceeds 5000

behaviours.title: A single withdrawal of 5000.01 exceeds the limit
behaviours.when: 5000.01 is withdrawn
behaviours.then: it is rejected with 'daily-limit' and the balance stays 10000
behaviours.contrary_then: it is accepted and the balance becomes 4974.99

behaviours.title: Insufficient funds is reported before the withdrawal limit
behaviours.when: 6000 is withdrawn
behaviours.then: it is rejected with 'insufficient-funds'
behaviours.contrary_then: it is rejected with 'daily-limit'

behaviours.title: Zero or negative withdrawals are 'invalid-amount'
behaviours.when: 0 is withdrawn, and -10 is withdrawn
behaviours.then: both are rejected with 'invalid-amount' and the balance stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: a withdrawal of 0 is accepted and only the 0.50 minimum fee is charged

behaviours.title: A withdrawal reusing any earlier transaction id is ignored
behaviours.given: 100 has been deposited into 'a' with transaction 'x'
behaviours.when: 10 is withdrawn with 'x', then 10 is withdrawn twice with 'w1'
behaviours.then: the 'x' withdrawal reports ok but does nothing; only one 'w1' withdrawal applies, so the balance is 89.5
behaviours.contrary_then: both 'w1' withdrawals apply and the balance is 79

behaviours.title: A transfer moves the amount with no fee and records out/in entries
behaviours.when: 30 is transferred from 'a' to 'b' with transaction 't1'
behaviours.then: 'a' has 70 and 'b' has 30; 'a' records 'transfer-out' 30 and 'b' records 'transfer-in' 30
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal fee of 0.50 is also charged and 'a' has 69.5

behaviours.title: A transfer may empty the account exactly but not overdraw it
behaviours.when: 100.01 is transferred to 'b', then 100 is transferred to 'b'
behaviours.then: 100.01 is rejected with 'insufficient-funds'; 100 is accepted, leaving 'a' at 0 and 'b' at 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the 100 transfer is rejected because the balance must stay above 0

behaviours.title: A transfer to the same account is accepted and leaves the balance unchanged
behaviours.given: a balance of 100 in 'a' from deposit 'd1'
behaviours.when: 30 is transferred from 'a' to 'a' with transaction 't1'
behaviours.then: it is accepted, the balance stays 100, and the history gains 'transfer-out' 30 and 'transfer-in' 30
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer is rejected because source and destination are the same

behaviours.title: Zero or negative transfers are 'invalid-amount'
behaviours.when: 0 and then -10 are transferred to 'b'
behaviours.then: both are rejected with 'invalid-amount'; 'a' stays 100 and 'b' 0
behaviours.contrary_then: a transfer of 0 is accepted as a no-op

behaviours.title: Repeating a transfer transaction id is a no-op
behaviours.when: 30 is transferred to 'b' twice with 't1'
behaviours.then: 'a' has 70 and 'b' has 30
behaviours.contrary_then: both transfers apply and 'a' has 40

behaviours.title: In a split, leftover cents go to the first recipients in list order
behaviours.when: 10 is split from 'a' to ['b', 'c', 'd']
behaviours.contrary_then: the leftover cent goes to the last recipient: 'b' 3.33 and 'd' 3.34

behaviours.title: A split too small for everyone gives the last recipient a 0 entry
behaviours.when: 0.02 is split from 'a' to ['b', 'c', 'd'] with transaction 's1'
behaviours.then: 'b' gets 0.01, 'c' 0.01, 'd' 0, and 'd' still has a 'split-in' entry of amount 0
behaviours.contrary_then: 'd' receives nothing and has no history entry

behaviours.title: A split with no recipients is refused; an invalid amount is reported first
behaviours.when: 10 is split to [], 0 is split to [], and -1 is split to ['b']
behaviours.then: the first is rejected with 'no-recipients'; the second and third with 'invalid-amount'; 'a' stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: splitting 0 to [] is reported as 'no-recipients'

behaviours.title: A split may empty the payer exactly but not overdraw it
behaviours.when: 10.01 is split to ['b', 'c'], then 10 is split to ['b', 'c']
behaviours.then: 10.01 is rejected with 'insufficient-funds' and nothing moves; 10 is accepted, 'a' becomes 0 and 'b' and 'c' get 5 each
behaviours.contrary_then: the split of 10 is rejected because the balance must stay above 0

behaviours.title: Repeating a split transaction id is a no-op
behaviours.when: 10 is split to ['b', 'c'] twice with 's1'
behaviours.then: 'a' has 90, 'b' 5 and 'c' 5
behaviours.contrary_then: both splits apply and 'a' has 80

behaviours.title: Interest is rounded down to the cent
behaviours.when: interest at 5% annual for 30 days is applied with 'i1' (exactly 4.1095...)
behaviours.then: 4.10 is credited as an 'interest' entry and the balance becomes 1004.1
behaviours.contrary_then: interest is rounded to the nearest cent, 4.11, and the balance becomes 1004.11

behaviours.title: Interest uses a 365-day year
behaviours.when: interest at 36% annual for 10 days is applied
behaviours.then: 9.86 is credited and the balance becomes 1009.86
behaviours.contrary_then: a 360-day year is used, 10.00 is credited and the balance becomes 1010

behaviours.title: Interest that rounds to 0 reports ok, records nothing, and leaves the id reusable
behaviours.when: interest at 1% for 1 day is applied with 'i1'; then 1000 is deposited and interest at 36% for 10 days is applied again with 'i1'
behaviours.then: the first call reports ok with no entry and balance 1; the second call credits 9.87 and the balance becomes 1010.87
behaviours.contrary_then: the second call is treated as a repeat of 'i1' and ignored, leaving the balance at 1001

behaviours.title: Interest with a zero or negative rate or days is 'invalid-amount'
behaviours.when: interest is applied at 0% for 30 days, at 5% for 0 days, and at -5% for 30 days
behaviours.then: all three are rejected with 'invalid-amount' and the balance stays 1000
behaviours.contrary_then: a 0% rate is accepted as a no-op

behaviours.title: Repeating an interest transaction id is a no-op
behaviours.when: interest at 36% for 10 days is applied twice with 'i1'
behaviours.then: the balance is 1009.86
behaviours.contrary_then: interest is credited again on the new balance and it becomes 1019.82
